proposals.before: When the imperial army recovered the capital he was due for the extreme penalty; Lin was already over seventy, and Li Sheng pitied his age and memorialized to reduce the sentence to death.
proposals.after: When the imperial army recovered the capital he was due for the extreme penalty; Lin was already over seventy, and Li Sheng pitied his age and memorialized to commute the death sentence.
proposals.reason: 減死 means commute/reduce a death sentence, not reduce the sentence to death.

decisions.reason: s0123 ends 表請減死: Li Sheng petitioned to commute the death penalty already implied by 當處極刑. "Reduce the sentence to death" reverses that meaning; "commute the death sentence" matches 減死 and the next unit's refused-execution outcome.
The same focus unit has 表請減死; the literal likewise turns commutation into "reduce … to death." The proposed "commute the death sentence" restores the Chinese sense without other changes.
